title.title: Section Title
title.description: The title of the section which will be displayed in the page sidebar.

example.title: Example ID
example.description: The ID of the example to associate with all pages in the section that do not have an example explicitly defined.

nav_order.title: Navigation Order
nav_order.description: Determines the order of this section in the page sidebar. Sections with no defined order will appear below those with an order defined.

title.title: Category Title
title.description: The title of the category which will be displayed in the page sidebar. Also acts as the identifier used when adding pages to the category.

color.title: Category Color
color.description: Determines the color of the category title underline in the page sidebar.
